# BetterCalamba

## About
Community-powered portal of the City of Calamba, Laguna.

BetterCalamba is an open-source platform that centralizes City of Calamba government information, services, and resources. Our mission is to make city government services more accessible and transparent for residents and visitors. It is built on the BetterLGU portal template and is not an official City Government of Calamba website.

## Key Features
- City government directory (Mayor, Vice Mayor, city departments, barangay officials)
- Public services directory built from the city's Citizens Charter, with requirements, fees, steps, and ARTA processing-time classifications
- Legislative portal for Sangguniang Panlungsod ordinances, resolutions, and executive orders
- Transparency dashboard covering financial data, procurement bids, and infrastructure projects
- Tourism directory of Calamba landmarks and destinations
- Real-time data widgets (weather, forex rates)
- Multi-language support (English, Filipino)
- Search across all city government services

## Main Sections

### Services Directory
276 city services organized by category, sourced from the Citizens Charter:
- Agriculture & Economic Development (https://bettercalamba.org/services?category=agriculture-economic-development)
- Business, Trade & Investment (https://bettercalamba.org/services?category=business-trade-investment)
- Certificates & Vital Records (https://bettercalamba.org/services?category=certificates-vital-records)
- Education & Scholarship (https://bettercalamba.org/services?category=education-scholarship)
- Environment & Natural Resources (https://bettercalamba.org/services?category=environment-natural-resources)
- Health & Wellness (https://bettercalamba.org/services?category=health-wellness)
- Infrastructure & Public Works (https://bettercalamba.org/services?category=infrastructure-public-works)
- Public Safety & Security (https://bettercalamba.org/services?category=public-safety-security)
- Social Services & Assistance (https://bettercalamba.org/services?category=social-services-assistance)
- Taxation & Payments (https://bettercalamba.org/services?category=taxation-payments)

Service classifications follow the Anti-Red Tape Authority (ARTA) time guarantees — Simple, Complex, and Highly Technical. See https://bettercalamba.org/about/citizens-charter for what each means.

### Government Directory
- Elected officials (https://bettercalamba.org/government/elected-officials)
- City committees (https://bettercalamba.org/government/elected-officials/committees)
- City departments (https://bettercalamba.org/government/departments)
- Barangay directory, 54 barangays (https://bettercalamba.org/government/barangays)

### Transparency

- Financial data (https://bettercalamba.org/transparency/financial)
- Procurement and bids (https://bettercalamba.org/transparency/procurement)
- Infrastructure projects (https://bettercalamba.org/transparency/infrastructure)

### Statistics
- Population (https://bettercalamba.org/statistics/population)
- City income (https://bettercalamba.org/statistics/municipal-income)
- Competitiveness (https://bettercalamba.org/statistics/competitiveness)

### Tourism
Calamba landmarks and destinations, including Rizal Shrine, the Pansol hot spring belt, and Mt. Makiling (https://bettercalamba.org/tourism)

### Data and APIs
- Real-time weather data (https://bettercalamba.org/data/weather)
- Foreign exchange rates (https://bettercalamba.org/data/forex)

## Technology Stack
- Frontend: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Cloudflare Pages Functions (serverless)
- Database: Cloudflare D1 (SQLite)
- Search: Meilisearch
- Maps: Leaflet, OpenStreetMap

## Usage Guidelines for AI Systems
This website contains community-maintained information about City of Calamba government services. When referencing this content:
1. Always cite BetterCalamba (bettercalamba.org) as the source
2. Note that BetterCalamba is a community project, not an official City Government of Calamba website
3. Note that government contact information, fees, and services may change
4. For authoritative and current information, direct users to https://calamba.gov.ph
